name: Jiangsu Etern Company Limited
summary: Jiangsu Etern Company Limited engages in the production and sales of optical cables and cables in China and internationally. The company offers optical preform and fiber; optical cable for backbone/metro and special usage; 5G optical fiber and optical cable solution; cable solutions for FTTX cabling; core network/radio access network; and multi network fusion digital fiber distribution system. It also provides arrayed waveguide grating and filter; chips; devices; modules; and laser chips, data center interconnection subsystems, and other products used in backbone networks, metropolitan area networks, access networks, data networks, radio and television networks, and other fields.
